question: How should one undertake recitation of the hymn to fulfill a chosen desire?
premises: One first undertakes whatever desire is sought.
The recitation is to be performed on the bank of the Kālindī.
One should then recite the hymn.
inference: To fulfill a desire, one should undertake it and recite the hymn on the bank of the Kālindī.
uncertainties: The exact force of 'tvā' here is taken as a particle in context.
plain_english: Having undertaken whatever desire one seeks, one should then recite this hymn on the bank of the Kālindī.
